Name: Drake Marauder
Description:
Manufacturer: Drake Interplanetary
Focus: Medium Fighter

In a universe as treacherous as this one, pilots need a ship that flies faster and hits heavier - the Drake Marauder. Fitted with powerful main thrusters for quick hit-and-runs, and armed to the teeth with firepower, by the time your enemies spot you, it'll already be too late.
